title: Welcome to Elk
summary: Short story-focused biographical adventure built from real people's experiences, mixing animation, live-action testimony and light interactive scenes while moving mostly along a linear narrative path.

observations.statement: Several reviews praise the unusual true-story format, memorable characters and the blend of humorous and heavy personal material.
Limited agency and small minigames can make parts of the experience feel passive or interrupt the narrative flow for some players.
The Steam store explicitly lists Russian as unsupported.

conflicts.statement: The same story-first linearity that some reviewers found emotionally impactful was described by others as slow or difficult to engage with.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
